about_the_game:
Despite the ban, Katay found his way to Tulai City. It seems that the cunning rabbit is up to something, calling Maya along. But the naive traveler will only realize this when, instead of a warm welcome, the Tulai tribe takes Katay into custody. The court is determined to execute the God of Cunning for his many transgressions. Unless the other tribes bring him gifts.

In his pursuit of freedom, Katay will turn the island upside down! Some will lose their memories, others will find themselves in alien bodies, and still others may regret the fulfillment of their wishes. No one will be spared divine intervention.

How will the adventures of the hapless couple end? Will Maya be able to change the jury's mind? And whether other islanders will not want to join the execution of a long-eared prankster, you will find out in the new DLC “The Court of Tricksters”!
